title: [Search for facet values] Refinement list - InstantSearch.js
body:
*This is a preview PR and I would love your input on the implementation, as well as the configuration options. The commits will be squashed to have a proper history.*

**Summary**

This PR provides an implementation of options to be able to search into facet values in the refinementList widget. When activated it adds a search input on top of the list, the results are replacing the values in the list. Pressing return when there are search results, selects the first item.

The API tries to stay consistent with the current implementation with a configuration object that  defaults and with the following structure (using the structure enables the feature):
 - placeholder: string (plain text)
 - templates: object
 - templates.noResults: string (html  template)

**Result**

[See it live](http://bouncy-clam.surge.sh/) 🔥

Question about the behavior: if we sort the refinementList by `isRefined` first, shouldn't we sort the search for facet values results list the same way?

@mthuret this is a very valid question indeed. I failed to find a way to do that without extracting and moving the code sorting the values. I think this question is broader, because in instantsearch.js we let developers use custom sort, should we apply this one?

After testing it seems that the order is fine when returned from Algolia because we are searching. I will put an online version to let you test.

I managed to break it (Don't get me wrong, this is awesome, I just like to break stuff).

When the network is not reliable, slow, then some requests are cancelled and other one mades. Overall at some point you find yourself in a state that is different from the last time you went to that state.

It happens with the empty query it seems.
